observations: Black game console with a glossy finish.
One black DualShock 4 controller and one red DualShock 4 controller.
A power cable with a UK-style 3-pin plug.
A plastic bag containing a USB cable and a yellow power adapter.
The console is resting on a black box with 'PS4' visible on the side in photo 0.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GADGETSWORLD' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The console is shown in photo 0, but its condition and origin cannot be confirmed from a single photo.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen.
The seller's text mentions a 10k value for the extra pad, but this is not shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or a different model (e.g., PS4 Pro).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powered on and navigating the system menu.
Video showing the controllers connected and working.
Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sony PlayStation 4 from the box and controller design. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working) until proof of functionality is provided.
